set.sentence: A kuruc lovasság támadott, ____ a labanc sereg még táborozott.
set.english: The Kuruc cavalry attacked while the labanc army was still camping.

set.sentence: ____ a rézpénz értéke csökkent, a kurucok tovább harcoltak.
set.english: Although the value of the copper coin fell, the Kuruc kept fighting.
